title: Can every road be used once?
hook: Which vertices can hold the two loose ends of an edge-by-edge walk?

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Use odd-degree counts and connectivity to decide whether an undirected Euler trail exists.

misconception: A connected graph always admits an edge-once walk.
objective: Use odd-degree counts and connectivity to decide whether an undirected Euler trail exists.
